==Description==
The '''Violent Night Event''' was the eleventh event to be added in Tower Defense Simulator. This event brought one new event tower, the [[Elf Camp]], which is the only event spawner tower. This event had a season pass, which required {{CandyCane|Candy Canes}} to reach higher ranks.

This event started on the 21st of December 2022 and ended on the 4th of February 2023. The season pass ended on the 15th of January 2023.

==Violent Night Season Pass==
[[File:ViolentNightSeason.png|center|500px|thumb]]
{{CandyCane|Candy Canes}} were this event's currency. They were collected by killing enemies that spawned with randomly chosen Christmas-themed hats. Most of these hats were worn by enemies that appeared in this event. All naturally spawned enemies could spawn with one of these hats. These enemies would drop between one and three {{CandyCane|Candy Canes}} when killed, which had to be collected by walking up to them.

In total, it would take {{CandyCane|2,500 Candy Canes}} or {{Robux|2,810}} to complete the season pass.

==Trivia==
*Multiple anti-Santa posters made by the elves could have been seen in the lobby as part of the event. These posters were:
**"''RUDOLPH THE RED-NOSED CLASS TRAITOR''" with an image of a Rudolph plushie with a blue fire background.
**"Krampus says ''LET 'EM HAVE IT''" with a render of [[Mecha-claus]] holding its gift launcher.
**"''CHRISTMAS IS OVER''" with an image of a Christmas tree being burnt.
**"''WE NEED YOU TO DESTROY SANTA''" with an image of three elves in front of a fire.
**"''CRUSH THE KRINGLE''" with an image of Santa.
*Multiple enemies that appeared in this event can be seen as units spawned by the [[Elf Camp]].
*The event might be named after [[wp:Violent Night|the movie of the same name]], or an alteration of the famous Christmas carol [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nEH7_2c644Q Silent Night].
*The '''Violent Night Event''' is the first event to include [[Matchmaking]] for duos and trios, as all other prior events with [[Matchmaking]] would only pair players in quads.
*Uniquely, unlike all other events that had a season pass, the '''Violent Night Season''' ended before the '''Violent Night Event''', instead of both of them ending at the same time.
*Originally, the '''Violent Night Event''' was supposed to have three nights/acts similar to the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]; they were most likely cut due to time restraints.
